132 likes, 3 comments - the_unconventional_ca on September 29, 2026: "Debt can give a growing company more time. But time only helps if the business can eventually generate enough cash to pay it back.

The Good Glamm Group story is a good example of why venture debt and cash flow need to be looked at together.

In a recent conversation with Aditya Singh, we got into what happens when the capital raised to fuel growth starts becoming a pressure on the business instead.

Because raising debt is one question. Having the cash flows to service it is another.

Full episode out now, link in bio

[venture debt, investment, sirona, good glamm group, business, podcast, economy, venture capital, india, entrepreneurship]".

948 likes, 21 comments - the_unconventional_ca on September 27, 2026: "₹80 lakh ki luxury car… effectively ₹27 lakh ki? 👀

Sounds ridiculous, until you understand how business owners look at expensive purchases.

Depreciation benefits.
Lower EV running costs.
Resale value.
Loan interest deductions.
And the part most people completely ignore — how the right asset can actually help you make more money.

An ₹80 lakh car is still an ₹80 lakh car. But what it ultimately costs you can be a very different number.

Watch till the end — because the most unconventional benefit has nothing to do with tax. 👀

Calculations are illustrative and depend on business use, tax structure, eligibility, financing, actual running costs and resale value. Consult a tax professional before making a purchase decision.

#Entrepreneurship #LuxuryCars #personalfinanceindia BusinessFinance MGIndia #MGM9 #MGCyberster PersonalFinance".

1,334 likes, 15 comments - the_unconventional_ca on August 13, 2026: "What actually goes into a pre-seed pitch deck?

Aditya Singh (All In Capital) broke it down to four slides:

01 — Team
02 — Product
03 — Problem in the market
04 — Your solution

And one rule most founders break: no more than 5 words on a slide. The investor came to listen, not to read.

Founders, save this one.

Full episode on YouTube — link in bio.

Keywords: pitch deck, pre seed funding, startup funding India, venture capital, how to pitch to investors, seed round, angel investment, fundraising, founder advice, VC funding, Indian startups, first time founder, investor pitch, startup tips, deck structure

#pitchdeck #startupfunding #venturecapital #founders #startupindia".

2,083 likes, 10 comments - the_unconventional_ca on July 28, 2026: "A great business can still become a terrible investment.

Most investors study balance sheets.

Very few study the people running the company.

Apurva Sharma shares how a promoter battle at Shalimar Paints turned a ₹150 stock into ₹50 and completely changed the way he invests.

Sometimes, the biggest risk isn’t the market.

It’s management.

Watch this one before you buy your next stock.

(Stock market India, Investing, Shalimar Paints, Corporate Governance, Promoter Conflict, Minority Shareholders, Value Investing, Investing Mistakes, Wealth Creation, Business Strategy)

#stockmarketindia #investing #wealthcreation #businessstrategy #personalfinance".
